rationale: The paper vocabulary: every block kind whose node names adapter "paper", the document kinds in folio-assistant-core and the math kinds here. cat-harness's BlockSchema types it, so its kinds are the platform's own and no contributor may redefine one. md and ts are shared by every block; lean is paper-only. Declared here because the vocabulary is completed by this layer's formal-claim kinds; the row stood in ADAPTER_COMPANION_ROLES in cat-harness/schemas/block-qa.ts until bean riit, step 5.
